You may speak for as long as you wish.
What are the steps involved when people have to do laundry?
model_evidence: model and effort in native CLI rollout turn_context record
raw: First you sort the clothes, check the pockets and labels, then put a load in the machine with detergent and choose the right wash setting. When it’s finished, hang them up or use the dryer—then fold them and put them away once they’re dry.
